2) A number of our infra/engineering staff are traveling for a partner summit the week of 2026-12-07, which limits deep technical availability then.

Given that, I can offer two practical options:
- Option A (short): A 30-minute executive-focused demo on Thu 2026-12-16 at 10:00 AM PST (overview + latency/cost numbers).
- Option B (technical): A 60-minute hands-on walkthrough with a solutions engineer on Fri 2027-01-08 at 11:00 AM PST (full Q&A, notebook run).

If you need something earlier and focused on throughput/latency only, Lauren can coordinate a compact session that Monica (our SE) can run before the partner summit — but it will be scoped to the pilot's happy path.

Which would you prefer? If Option A works we can lock the calendar and send a short agenda.

Thanks,
